verdict.rationale: Stripe provides the underlying building blocks—an API-based Terminal integration, a Payouts API, an OpenAPI spec, and an official MCP server explicitly aimed at letting AI agents call Stripe's API—which together would let an agent pull transaction and payout data programmatically. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated reconciliation feature, ledger-sync tooling, or documentation showing an agent actually matching daily takings to a ledger. Missing for 10: explicit reconciliation/ledger-matching docs, a demonstrated agent workflow pulling both transactions and payouts together, and independent confirmation the MCP server supports these specific read operations.
